pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome from the Head of Sixth Form - Ashcroft Technology Academy
pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Head of Sixth Form
The Sixth Form at Ashcroft Technology Academy has a strong academic ethos and offers an environment in which students are supported to achieve the very highest levels of academic achievement. Following their Sixth Form studies, our students typically progress to Russell Group universities, studying a range of academic courses. Our students are well prepared to meet the challenges that these courses present as a result of the knowledge and skills they develop during their time in the Sixth Form.
The Academy has an established reputation for excellence in teaching, learning and results and we are proud of the achievements our students make each year. We have inspiring resources for your continuing studies, high-quality, research-led teaching, and we offer a broad curriculum with an extensive range of courses.
The successes our students achieve have been recognised both locally and nationally. We are especially pleased to have won the Wandsworth Pupil Achievement Award for highest A - Level results in Wandsworth borough every year since 2013. We have also been recognised at a national level with an award for the excellent progress our Sixth Form students make (the Learning Plus UK student progress award). These awards are testament to this being a Sixth Form where the combination of hard work and outstanding teaching allows students to reach their full potential.
The Academy was one of the first schools in the country to be inspected under Ofsted’s new and more demanding inspection framework. Inspectors were hugely impressed with the Academy and the outcome reflects this. Ofsted rated the Academy Exceptional in five areas, the most any school has been awarded under the new framework.
Ofsted states that “We only award this grade when we see practice that is among the very best nationally, which should be shared with other schools or providers to help them improve.”
I am particularly pleased to share the judgement for our Sixth Form, which was rated Exceptional.
Inspectors found that:
“There is an ambitious and well-structured post-16 study programme that prepares students so well for university, apprenticeships and employment.”
“The delivery of the post-16 curriculum is of a consistent high quality. Teachers explain concepts clearly and check understanding regularly, so students build confidence and achieve excellent results.”
“Leaders monitor progress closely and intervene quickly when needed, ensuring that all students achieve well.”
“Careers education is comprehensive and begins early, with impartial advice, employer-led events and targeted workshops.”
“Sustained high expectations, expert teaching and strong pastoral care mean that students leave Ashcroft well prepared for their next steps and for life beyond school.”
This judgement sits alongside Exceptional ratings for Achievement, Curriculum and Teaching, Attendance and Behaviour and Leadership and Governance, illustrating the strength, ambition and consistency of education that students experience at the Academy.
Sixth Form students have the choice of two programmes of study: A-Levels or the International Baccalaureate, the latter of which is a broad and highly-regarded qualification, offered mainly in the independent sector. A-Level students typically study three subjects, with the option open to students who study Maths and Further Maths to study a fourth subject to maintain a good balance. In addition to their A-Level and IB courses, all Sixth Form students follow a weekly pastoral programme, which includes comprehensive guidance on UCAS preparation, career pathways, and support with their own personal and academic development and independent study skills. Furthermore, our extensive super-curricular programme in the Sixth Form provides supplementary opportunities and encouragement to our students who intend to apply to the most prestigious universities in the UK and abroad. This includes the opportunity to complete an Extended Project Qualification in a subject of a student’s choosing and to participate in our support programme for aspiring Medics and Oxbridge candidates.
The Academy has recently increased the teaching time allocated to A-level subjects by 25%. This investment of time represents a significant commitment by the Academy to make sure that students who study here are supported to give of their best with the best possible preparation for their exams.
In the Sixth Form, you will develop your academic independence and take responsibility for your own learning; however our teachers, tutors and Sixth Form Management Team are outstanding and always willing to help, support and advise. We also recognise the importance of learning beyond the classroom and so you will find a superb range of super-curricular and extra-curricular activities available for you to participate in and enjoy during your time in the Sixth Form.
We look forward to welcoming you to the Sixth Form at Ashcroft Technology Academy and working with you in pursuit of your ambitions.
Deputy Principal – Head of Sixth Form

pageCache.pageTitle: Early Careers Framework at ATA - Ashcroft Technology Academy
pageCache.text:
Early Careers Framework at ATA
We have a proven track record of developing outstanding classroom teachers from the very beginning of their careers. Many candidates applying for positions at the Academy cite our commitment to professional learning and development, and our consistent focus on behaviour management, as key reasons for wanting to work with us. These strengths were also highlighted and celebrated in our Ofsted inspection (December 2025).
“They provide excellent support for teachers, including high-quality, bespoke training and mentoring for new staff.” (Ofsted, 2025)
At ATA, we have very high expectations for both behaviour and academic achievement. These expectations are reflected in our routines, the standards we set, and the pastoral and academic support we provide, ensuring the best possible outcomes for every student. Our commitment extends equally to staff, at every stage of their career, through a culture of ambitious and sustained professional development.
We believe that students thrive academically when they are able to learn in a well-ordered and well-managed environment. To achieve this, we operate a clear behaviour policy that consistently promotes positive learning behaviours. As a new teacher at ATA, you will be fully supported by the Leadership Group, ensuring that lessons take place in calm, purposeful classrooms where disruption is rare.
Early Career Teachers (ECTs) beginning their careers with us therefore benefit from a disciplined and positive learning environment, allowing them to focus on refining their pedagogy and delivering excellent lessons.
Our bespoke and comprehensive ECT programme goes beyond statutory requirements to provide an exceptional package of support. This combines the latest educational research, proven classroom strategies, and insights from cognitive science to help new teachers establish rigorous classrooms where student learning is always at the core.
From September 2025, significant changes have been made to the structure of Initial Teacher Training (ITT) and the Early Career Framework (ECF), creating a more integrated system of teacher development. At ATA, we are fully committed to ensuring a seamless transition from initial training into the Early Career phase. Our ITT provision and ECT programme are closely aligned, enabling trainees to build on their learning without repetition or gaps. Trainee teachers who progress into their ECT years at the Academy will therefore experience a continuous, carefully sequenced pathway of professional development—ensuring that the high standards, support, and mentoring they receive during training are sustained and deepened as they begin their teaching careers.

pageCache.text:
First Impressions
Naeemah – Head Student
I did not have to deliberate for long to decide that Ashcroft was my first choice for Sixth Form. I was fully aware that ATA could match my ambition, help me to harness the academic potential I knew I was capable of as well as prepare me for the future world of further education and work. It has done so, by offering a network of teachers and staff who are incredibly supportive and help to foster my desire to learn and explore. All the help I could possibly ask for in preparing for my exams, applying for university, and ensuring I make the right choice in regards to choosing my future career has been provided for me here, enabling me to create a strong foundation for my future.
Ashcroft offers you more than just academic support. In my time in Year 12, I have been able to take part in a plethora of activities beyond the curriculum. Not only can you join societies that target specific career paths, such as psychology and law, but you also have opportunities to get involved with house competitions and super-curricular activities, like inter-house Model United Nations and the Bar Mock Trial. Student run clubs also showcase the leadership and initiative developed by the Ashcroft Sixth Form and demonstrating their authentic passion in their chosen subjects. The number of opportunities available to you here outside of the curriculum ensure no two students’ experiences are the same, and that your time here is always engaging and offering something to look forward to.
I chose to study Biology, Chemistry and Psychology for my A-Levels, as it was the combination which suited my desire to continue delving into the world of science and to grow my ever-evolving love of psychology . This means I spend my time learning about a broad range of captivating topics, from the structure of organic molecules to schizophrenia , and everything in between. As a result of the skills I have cultivated at Ashcroft, I am now in a position to apply to study Psychology at university, a competitive course I am excited to get stuck in to.
Josie - Deputy Head Student
When I first joined the Sixth Form, I was immediately struck by the remarkable sense of community that is fostered at the Academy. The teachers here are truly dedicated to pushing their students to achieve their utmost potential, helping us to do our very best. Our journey towards success is supported by the exceptional Sixth Form team, who guide us throughout our academic endeavours and provide numerous opportunities to grow holistically as people beyond the classroom. This environment has played a pivotal role in shaping my academic path and aiding me in making informed decisions about what I aspire to study at university, a choice that is often challenging to make.
In addition to the exceptional academic support, the Sixth Form team goes above and beyond in assisting us through the demanding process of university applications. They are always more than happy to help along the journey, and any stress is eased through manageable deadlines and invaluable one-to-one guidance. Ashcroft is the doorstop that props every possible door open, offering opportunities, encouragement, and the confidence to step through them. Choosing Ashcroft Sixth Form has undoubtedly been the greatest decision I have made in my academic life, as it has not only propelled me toward personal growth and achievement but has also immersed me in a welcoming and diverse community.
The bonds formed within the Academy are built on friendship, respect, and a shared desire to excel. My experiences here have equipped me with the skills and mindset necessary to thrive in university and beyond.
Abac - Head Student Team
Right from the start of my first week in the Sixth Form, it was clear that, by choosing Ashcroft, I had made the best possible choice for my education. I knew it would prepare me academically, personally, and professionally - for the future I am aiming for.
As you can imagine, it was a little nerve-racking entering a new environment when I joined the Academy at the start of Year 12. However, the Sixth Form allowed me to find my own stride, not just in terms of being a dedicated student but also as a young adult.
With the support I have been provided, I was able to instantly integrate into the Sixth Form and enjoy my studies. What really impressed me after joining the Sixth Form was the depth of the teachers' knowledge in their subject areas, and this too reassured me that I was learning from the best. Additionally, I love the balance of independence and support in this Sixth Form. Students have immense support from their teachers, yet we are also provided enough freedom to study independently and take ownership of our learning, for example, through study periods.
The structured and supportive atmosphere in the Sixth Form, as well as having clear expectations and strong teaching, aids you to stay motivated and on track. I knew this school will help me progress further to achieve the best possible grades in Year 13 and successfully pursue my long-term goals.
Elisabeth - Head Student Team
I moved to Ashcroft at the start of Year 12. Immediately, I was welcomed warmly by the friendly students and supportive teachers and felt part of the Academy. The transition to Sixth Form and a new school was a big step, however I was supported from the very first moment I entered the Academy. I am delighted with my decision to study A-Levels at Ashcroft. The focus on academia in this ambitious environment has spurred me on to aim for A*s. In particular, the focused classes have encouraged me to be more proactive in lessons. They also mean I receive personalised feedback on my academic progress, encouraging me to always improve and grow.
The Ashcroft Sixth Form is not just about academics. Here, I have been encouraged to expand my interests and step out of my comfort zone, developing new skills. For instance, participating in events such as the Bar Mock Trial and Model United Nations conferences have strengthened my public speaking abilities. This has massively improved both my writing and public speaking skills which I have been able to adopt in my academics as well as my own super curricular endeavours.
In my opinion, the most valuable element of the Academy is its commitment to support students to prepare for life beyond Sixth Form. Students have access to universities, counsellors, and career guidance both in the UK and internationally. This means I feel confident in my application to study politics at university. The constant range of invaluable super-curricular opportunities for students to engage in, such as university lectures and the Law Society, encouraging me to be the confident, well-rounded person I am today.
Ava - Head Student Team
As someone who spent her entire secondary education at Ashcroft, choosing to continue into the Sixth Form was an easy decision. I had already experienced the high standards of teaching and, more importantly, the deeply supportive community that the academy fosters.
The Sixth Form environment is both challenging and encouraging. There are plenty of opportunities beyond the curriculum to get involved in - not just within the Sixth Form, but throughout the school, such as tutoring younger years. Taking part in these activities has helped strengthen my self-assurance.
Beyond academics, Ashcroft provides a space where I feel constantly supported, whether through leadership opportunities, external competitions, or tailored guidance for university applications. The sense of community, both among students and staff, has helped me grow in confidence and resilience.
Ashcroft doesn’t just prepare me for exams, it prepares me for life. I know the strong sense of community here is shaping a future I’m excited about.
Adam - Head Student Team
Upon my arrival on my first day of Sixth Form at Ashcroft, I was warmly welcomed by the diverse community of students and teachers. I was able to meet very nice people, as well as reconnect with previous friends, which boosted my confidence. I recognised once again that Ashcroft is a place where everyone is valued and respected, regardless of their background, and I am grateful to be part of such a welcoming environment.
Sixth Form life is vastly different to secondary school life; there is a greater workload as well as higher expectations. From the start, Ashcroft was extremely supportive with my studies and university plans, particularly as I hope to study Chemistry at university. I feel Ashcroft has provided me with useful resources and an insight into Chemistry through the Molecular Science Club they have organised and the extended access to the labs that we get throughout the year as part of our chemistry course in addition to this, there is a great choice of extra curriculars in school and a wide range of super-curriculars that are tailored to our specific subject choices. Ashcroft also provides a great house system that gives us students the opportunity to take part in competitions, for example: The Great Ashcroft Bake Off, inter-house basketball and dodgeball and the Ashcroft Quiz competition, all of which are open to all years, promoting inclusivity. And as I love competing, particularly in sports, I have found that all these competitions organised by the academy are really helpful to take a break from the fast-paced life at the academy and enjoy life at the Sixth Form.
Being a student as Ashcroft has increased my confidence academically and hugely and I know that at Ashcroft I can strive to do my absolute best.

In 2026, almost 10% of our Year 13 students progressed to Oxbridge or Medical School, while 72% of students continuing their studies in the UK progressed to Russell Group universities. The modal set of results was A*AA, and with an average IB score of 40 points, we receive the annual award of IB State School of the Year for academic achievement.
Our Sixth Form open evening is on Tuesday 06 October 2026 between 18:00 – 20:00.
Please arrive by 18:00 for presentations by the Head Student Team, Principal and Head of Sixth Form.
At the Open Evening you will have the opportunity to tour the Academy and to discuss all aspects of Sixth Form life with teachers and students. Tours will take place in small groups, led by current students, lasting around 30 minutes.
Opening Mornings for September 2027 intake: Wednesday 07 and Thursday 08 October 2026 09.00 – 10.30
Visitors will be met by the Head of Sixth Form and will have the opportunity to visit Sixth Form lessons and the Sixth Form Centre. Tours will be led by senior staff and current Sixth Form students, providing an opportunity for informal questions and answers during the tours. Please note that admission to the Open Mornings are only available to those who have booked in advance.

Examination Results
Our former Year 11 students achieved excellent GCSE results this summer. 53% of all grades were awarded at grades 7, 8 & 9 with 89% achieving a grade 4 or better in both English Language and Maths. It is always rewarding for the staff who support our young people through their education path, and never more so when that path ends at such a high level of achievement. These results are the culmination of thousands of hours of revision, teaching, support and drive.
Only the week before we saw equally impressive results from our former Year 13 students. Students taking all programmes of study in the Sixth Form performed significantly above local and national statistics. We are particularly pleased with the number of top grades: 94% of all grades were awarded at A*-C whilst 51% of all grades were awarded at A*-A. This year our students will be pursuing their degrees at prestigious establishments such as the University of Cambridge and the University of Oxford, and for highly competitive courses such as Medicine, Dentistry and Veterinary Sciences.
Lastly, students studying the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme achieved exceptional examination result in July. With 97% of grades achieved at a 5, 6 or 7 (where 7 is the maximum possible), the average points score per student of 40 out of 45.
Across all A Levels and the International Baccalaureate Diploma, over 57% of grades were A - A* or 6 - 7.

pageCache.pageTitle: Professional Learning and Development at ATA - Ashcroft Technology Academy
pageCache.text:
Professional Learning and Development at ATA
Providing high-quality and highly effective professional development for our teaching staff is a central part of the Academy’s ethos. It is a key driver behind our consistently exceptional public examination results and a reason why new entrants to the profession apply to join our team each year. Our professional development was also recognised and championed in our most recent Ofsted inspection in December, 2025.
“Teaching is supported by high-quality professional development and collaborative feedback, which helps the school maintain the highest standards.” (Ofsted, 2025)
High-quality teaching is proven to have the greatest impact on student outcomes. This is why the Academy invests significantly in its professional development programme for staff.
All teachers follow a research-informed and carefully planned professional learning curriculum that focuses both on how students learn and on how to create rigorous and effective classrooms. Professional development takes place weekly, with each session linked to a termly theme. Each theme sits within a carefully sequenced annual curriculum. This “little and often” approach enables staff to continually review and refine their practice.
We achieve this by adopting a granular approach, focusing on one specific aspect of pedagogy at a time. Teachers plan lessons with the focus in mind, film themselves in the classroom, and then review clips individually and with a coaching partner. These reflections lead to purposeful adaptations in practice, establishing embedded routines and habits that support outstanding teaching. All teachers are fully engaged with this approach, underpinned by the shared belief that professional growth is always possible - not because they are not already good enough, but because there is always room to be even better.
In addition to our flagship professional development programme, we deliver all Early Career Teacher (ECT) and Initial Teacher Training (ITT) within the Academy. These programmes ensure that colleagues at the start of their career are not only well prepared to meet national teaching standards but also equipped to meet the standard of excellence we set for ourselves at the Academy, enabling our students to achieve exceptional success.
